t.zh: 同一样东西可以在一句话里出现好几次，等量代换只换点上的那几处。
t.en: One thing can appear several times in a sentence, and rewriting replaces only the places ticked.

brief.zh: 已知 p：「晨星 = 昏星」、q：「晨星很亮 ∧ 晨星看得见」，证出「昏星很亮 ∧ 晨星看得见」。
brief.en: Given p: “the Morning Star = the Evening Star” and q: “the Morning Star is bright ∧ the Morning Star can be seen”, prove “the Evening Star is bright ∧ the Morning Star can be seen”.

hint.zh: 每个框都点上，证出的是哪一句？
hint.en: With every box ticked, which sentence is proved?

brief.zh: 从已知 p：「晨星 = 昏星」、q：「晨星很亮 ∧ 昏星看得见」证出「昏星很亮 ∧ 晨星看得见」。
brief.en: From p: “the Morning Star = the Evening Star” and q: “the Morning Star is bright ∧ the Evening Star can be seen”, prove “the Evening Star is bright ∧ the Morning Star can be seen”.

hint.zh: 一处要把晨星换成昏星，另一处要把昏星换成晨星。
hint.en: One place wants the Morning Star turned into the Evening Star, the other the Evening Star into the Morning Star.

hint.zh: 第二种换法要一个倒过来的等式。
hint.en: The second wants the equation turned round.
